messages.text: Searched the catalog · Hammer Miner DC06 330 MH/s scrypt
Looked up for Sarah: DC06 is live at $379.99, down from $499.99, in stock; 105 W runs about $12 a month at 16¢. Doge/Litecoin solo-lottery miner.
Looked up for Sarah: At 16¢ the DC06's 105 watts costs about $12 a month — roughly 76 kWh — and it solo-mines Doge and Litecoin blocks round the clock.

Hey, I'm Sarah! I know every miner we carry, and I'm here to help. Over twelve cents, okay, so the power bill matters, and I'll run the Hammer Miner DC06 honestly at your rate. Roughly what do you pay, fifteen, twenty? Tap an answer, or the mic and tell me.
Looked up for Sarah: They already gave 16¢ — don't ask again. A Doge block pays 10,000 DOGE, about $1,500; the DC06 draws for one every minute, 24/7, for $12 a month.
At sixteen cents, the DC06 costs about twelve dollars a month in power to run. Do you want a shot at a block, or steady Doge stacking up?

Good, that's what this one's for. The D.06 takes a shot at Doge and Litecoin blocks around the clock. That's about twelve dollars a month in power, and it's three seventy-nine ninety-nine. Want it? (The call ended. 2 shopper turn(s). Reply NOTHING.)
